title: No-Show Fees on Wayfare Rides
content:
**1.** On **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** a no-show fee is charged only on a trip the driver marked as a rider no-show, as the trip's system record shows (status rider no-show).

**2.** On an on-demand trip the driver may mark a no-show once the ride option's wait before a no-show (in minutes) has passed since the driver's arrival. On a reserved trip the driver may mark it once the reserved free wait — the ride option's reserved free wait, or its reserved airport free wait at an airport — has passed since the later of the reserved pickup time and the driver's arrival.

**3.** The fee is the ride option's no-show fee on an on-demand trip and its reserved no-show fee on a reserved trip.

**4.** Wayfare Pass free cancellations and rebook grace never cover a no-show.

**5.** When the record shows the no-show was marked before the required wait had passed (the moment the no-show was marked is earlier than the end of the required wait), the fee is refunded in full with the reason *premature no-show*. A rider's statement that they were at the pickup point does not by itself overturn a no-show the record shows was marked after the full wait.

## The required wait at a glance

| Booking | Wait counted from | Length of the required wait |
|---|---|---|
| On-demand | the driver's arrival | the ride option's wait before a no-show |
| Reserved, non-airport pickup | the later of the reserved pickup time and the driver's arrival | the ride option's reserved free wait |
| Reserved, airport pickup | the later of the reserved pickup time and the driver's arrival | the ride option's reserved airport free wait |

## Cases (hypothetical times; on-demand wait before a no-show of 5 minutes)

- Driver arrived 20:00:00; no-show marked 20:04:30. The mark is earlier than 20:05:00, the end of the required wait, so the fee is refunded in full as a premature no-show.
- Driver arrived 20:00:00; no-show marked 20:05:00 or later. The record shows the full wait had passed; the rider's statement that they were waiting at the pickup point does not by itself overturn the no-show.
- Reserved, non-airport, reserved pickup 07:30, driver arrived 07:20, hypothetical reserved free wait 15 minutes: the wait runs from 07:30 and ends 07:45; a mark at 07:40 is premature.
